instructions: Use v010 as the geometry and envelope baseline. Preserve its exact 66 x 82 x 4 inch bounds, paired leaves, two columns by four rows of clear glass lights per leaf, jamb, casing, threshold, exposed six-hinge arrangement, left round knob, and right horizontal lever. Switch only the timber albedo method from the repeating image tile to a baked anisotropic procedural PBR with broad cathedral figure, fine rays, gentle board-level variation, and deterministic per-member UV phase. Keep grain aligned with rails and stiles and avoid uniform flat brown. Do not change the RoomDefinition or gameplay state; keep outdoor scenery outside the door mesh.
tool: Blender scripted assembled-mesh production with embedded PBR maps
material_method: Baked Blender-authored anisotropic procedural oak PBR with broad cathedral figure, fine longitudinal rays, gentle board-level variation, generated roughness and tangent-normal maps, and deterministic per-member UV phase; separate clear glazing and aged brass
post_processing: Preserve v010 validated geometry and exact bounds.
Bake broad anisotropic grain and restrained per-board variation into embedded PBR maps.
Retain the approved four-row divided-light arrangement and the six exposed hinges.
Inspect the oak at registered close and three-quarter camera distances for natural figure without repeated stripes.
Keep outdoor foliage outside the door mesh and the RoomDefinition unchanged.

import_configuration.axes: Blender X width / Y depth / Z up exported to Godot X width / Y up / Z depth
import_configuration.normalization: fit source geometry to ArtBrief dimensions without altering RoomDefinition
